# openvidstudio

> Free, open-source video-generation add-on for any software project, driven entirely through MCP tools

openvidstudio is an open-source node project maintained at
[github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio) under the
Apache-2.0 license. openvidstudio's own code is free for everyone, including companies of any
size. It renders through Remotion, which is free for individuals and for-profit companies with
up to 3 employees; a larger company needs a separate Remotion Company License
([remotion.pro](https://www.remotion.pro/license)) to render with it. See README's Tech stack
section.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a short, stable,
plain-language map of the project for language models and the people using them. Keep it
current when the links below move, and keep it short: it is an index, not documentation.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/README.md): what this is, why
  it exists, and how to install and run it.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed
  in each release, newest first.
- [TOOLS](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/TOOLS.md): every
  MCP tool with a one-line purpose, generated from the server's own registry (including
  `compose_score`, the original-score tool, and `render_stills`, the review loop's instrument).
- [CREATIVE](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/CREATIVE.md): the
  craft of directing a video: story, hook, motif, copy, pacing to music, camera, review rubric.
- [PIPELINE](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/PIPELINE.md) and
  [API](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/API.md): the order of
  work, and every `@openvidstudio/core` primitive with a rendered still.

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup,
  the verification commands (`pnpm --filter <package> build`/`test`), and what a good pull
  request looks like.
- [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- Good first issues: Check the issues tab for the current list.

## Security

- [Security policy](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report
  vulnerabilities privately to dhawansanay@gmail.com, not as a public issue.

## Optional

- [Issues](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/issues): current bugs and roadmap.
- [Releases](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/releases): tagged versions and notes.
